reward: Terminal team win/draw/loss only, undiscounted Monte Carlo; match-balanced weighting. Auxiliary predictions of 20-round child/parent survival and observed positive net growth; no split-count or death reward.
scope: Only spatial-ppo and gru-ppo families; two training seeds each. Frozen v4 movement weights and original observation path. New tail-map/candidate encoder trains separately. Rules-only dynamic feeding evaluated after split selection.
adaptation: From update 3, double learning rate up to 0.0006 only if preceding training-state greedy rule disagreement is below 0.5%; never inspect independent tests for adaptation.
selection: Select original rule, aggressive split rule or one of two trained checkpoints per architecture by 8 validation cases; ties prefer original, then aggressive, then lower training seed. Evaluate dynamic feeding on 4 matched validation cases, ties retain original. Freeze all choices before 8 independent tests per architecture. Independent test also includes a matched original-rule control when selected policy differs; these outcomes never alter selection.
